content: Yesu ꞌina etala Pailato matanaya
Tomwa ꞌiulisina ga totaliyao sinabwadi be ꞌinapwanao maiboꞌadi siloiloina be ꞌaene Yesu siloemwawasi.
ꞌEnega Yesu nimana siyonidi ga sitauyena toloina sinabwana Pailato ꞌenaya be ꞌaene Pailato nina ꞌida loine.
Yudasa ꞌina mwawasa
Ta Yudasa nina ꞌimwalatonina ꞌaene Yesu ꞌiabe siloemwawasi, ꞌenega ꞌinuwaꞌebuni ga ꞌina mani gulewa teti ꞌiiledi totaliyao be ꞌinapwanao ꞌediya,
ta ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu yaloegesi, manuna tai boboꞌana ꞌemiya yasipupuyenaya.” Ta sigwae, “Nate nigeya ꞌebweu toꞌase ꞌemaya ta ꞌoyo tuga manuna ꞌuda nuwanuwa.”
ꞌEnega mani teti nidi ꞌiula mwaꞌutedi Anuwa Tabu solanaya, ta ꞌiapwesa ga ꞌitauya, ga balaeyega ꞌotona tauna ꞌididimagena ga ꞌimwawasa.
Ta totaliyao nidi mani nidi siegogonedi ga sigwae, “Nigeya sawesawenaya be Yaubada ꞌana ꞌebwayadaita ꞌena tasaꞌui, manuna mani gete tomota ꞌana loemwawasa ꞌana eꞌisa.”
ꞌEnega taudimo siloina ga mani nina ꞌenega ꞌebweu toꞌabiꞌule ꞌina baleꞌu ꞌebweuna sigimwanena, be ꞌaene bwaꞌa nina ꞌowagao ꞌadi ꞌaliꞌali.
ꞌEnega bwaꞌa nina sieesena ‘Lala baleꞌuna’, ga esana nina maꞌetamo ꞌimiyami.

Gote ꞌenega palopita Yelemaiya ꞌina onaupaupa ꞌiapwesa, manuna lowa Buki Tabu ꞌena ꞌina ona siꞌetoladina ꞌaene, “Ga me Isileli tauna ꞌana maisa sibwauyena, nate gulewa siliba ꞌadi yau teti, ga mani nidi siꞌewedi,
ga ꞌenega toꞌabiꞌule ꞌina baleꞌu siemaisina, nadigega ꞌida ꞌInapwana ꞌiemataluwegu.”
Pailato Yesu ꞌienaidena
ꞌEnega Yesu Pailato matanaya sietoolona, tauna toloina sinabwana, ga Pailato nina Yesu ꞌienaidena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌUda simana, ꞌoyo me Yudia ꞌidi kini, aga?” Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu nate ꞌuona saba.”
ꞌEnega totaliyao sinabwadi be ꞌinapwanao Yesu sieꞌewena Pailato matanaya, ta Yesu nigeya ꞌebweu toꞌase ꞌieꞌieꞌisa.
Ta Pailato ꞌigwae, “Mwaꞌadega, simana getedi ꞌamu eꞌewa manuna ꞌunononaya?”
Ta Yesu nigeya wate ꞌieꞌieꞌisa, ta tuga ꞌiꞌala enonomo. ꞌEnega Pailato nina nuwana ꞌiowana sinabwana.
Pailato ꞌiloina be Yesu sida loemwawasi
Yakwala ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌediya, Ataona masulina ꞌenaya, toloina nina ꞌina bubuna nate deliyega ꞌebweu tai ꞌiliꞌami be ꞌiapwesa, ꞌeguma yaita pwalu siesinuwe.
Ta tuta gote ꞌena ꞌebweu tai deliya ꞌimiyami, ꞌana esana Balaba, tomota maiboꞌadi simwalatonina ꞌaene tauna totoꞌumalina sinabwana.
ꞌEnega tomota siegogonama Pailato ꞌenaya, ta Pailato ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “To tai nuwanuwami be manumi yaliꞌami? Balaba? nai Yesu, tauna sieesena Toꞌetoseyana?”
Manuna Pailato ꞌimwalatonina ꞌaene eꞌipiꞌipiyega Yesu siwasegigiyena sabi loemwawasina.

Ta wate tuta nina ꞌetamo Pailato etala ꞌiguiguinuwe, ta mwanena ale ꞌietunenama ga ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wate toꞌase ꞌuloiloine tai palupaluna gete manuna, manuna niꞌa yamadawalena ga ꞌebe matauta sinabwana ꞌeguya.”
Ta esi totaliyao sinabwadi be ꞌinapwanao tomota siloaꞌetuꞌetunedi be ꞌaene sisisida Pailato ꞌena be Balaba ꞌiliꞌami ꞌediya ta Yesu sida loemwawasi.
ꞌEnega toloina nina ꞌienaida limedi, ꞌigwae, “Siteluwa ꞌediyega yaita nuwanuwami be manumi yaliꞌami?” ꞌEnega sigwae, “Balaba.”
Ta Pailato ꞌigwae, “Ta mwaꞌadega yada loinaꞌesa Yesu, tauna sieesena Toꞌetoseyana?” ꞌEnega maiboꞌadi sigwae, “Kelose ꞌena tada tutuepaꞌiye!”
Ta Pailato ꞌieonedi, “Toꞌase sana ꞌina loegesi, ga ꞌenega ꞌaene mwawasa ꞌiloba?” Ta sibwau toitoila, sigwae, “Kelose ꞌenaya tada tutuepaꞌiye!”

ꞌEnega Pailato ꞌimwalatonina ꞌaene nigeya ꞌina waiwaimo, ta pwalu siegewagewana ꞌana ꞌita ꞌaene ꞌiabe sieꞌale be silosaiya. ꞌEnega bwasiyega nimana ꞌiꞌutudi boda nidi matadiya ta ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wate toꞌase yaloiloina tai boboꞌana gete ꞌina mwawasa manuna, ta ꞌomi namo wada loina.”
Ta boda maiboꞌadi sigwae, “Boboꞌana! ꞌAboꞌama ꞌada loine, ta ꞌana eꞌisa ꞌada loba, ꞌaboꞌama, ta ꞌepata simeemai ꞌediya wate.”
ꞌEnega Pailato ꞌidi ona ꞌinononaya, ta Balaba ꞌiliꞌamina, ta wate ꞌina tolosaiyao ꞌiloinedi be Yesu balaeyega sida sapi, be muliyega sida tutuepaꞌiye kelose ꞌenaya.
Tolosaiyao Yesu situyeyena
ꞌEnega toloina nina ꞌina tolosaiyao Yesu sisapina ta siluguyena ꞌidi anuwa sinabwana solanaya, ga ꞌidi boda maiboꞌadi sibwau egogonedima Yesu ꞌenaya,
ga ꞌana ꞌoamao sialolodi, ta ꞌoama esaesa ꞌenega sieꞌoamena sabi tuyeyena,

ga ꞌana peyaula kwakwakwala ꞌediyega siguinuwena ga debanaya sisaꞌuna, ta ꞌetoguna nima ꞌataina ꞌenaya sisaꞌuna, ta wate matanaya siꞌaetulasa ta situyeyena, sigwaegwae, “Kamatoki, ꞌoyo me Yudia ꞌidi kini ye!”
Ta wate sigiwalina, ga ꞌina ꞌetoguna siꞌewena ga ꞌenega debana sisapina.
ꞌEnega ꞌidi tuyeya ꞌigumwala, ga ꞌoama esaesa ꞌenega sialolona, ta tauna ꞌana ꞌoamega sieꞌote limena ga siꞌauꞌewena sabi giekelosena.
Yesu situtu epaꞌiyena kelose ꞌenaya
Ta Yesu siapwesena ga sitauyena, ta ꞌedaya goma Sailini ꞌebweu, ꞌana esana Saimoni, sialobena ga sididigena be ꞌaene Yesu ꞌana kelose ꞌida ꞌaali.
Ga Saimoni nina ꞌiꞌaalina ga ꞌana laba siapwesa sena Goligota ꞌenaya. (Goligota ꞌana mwalatoi nate “Bulubulu ꞌasana.”)
Ga oine be ꞌapasiꞌuma siꞌeinisena ga siꞌebwaꞌena be ꞌaene geyaꞌabo uya ꞌilotolotoo sinabwana, ta Yesu oine nina ꞌilotoonamoya ta ꞌiguitoyasena.

ꞌEnega kelose baleꞌuya sisaꞌunaya ta Yesu ꞌenaya situtu epaꞌiyena ga sietoolona, ga muliyega toguinuwa nidi Yesu ꞌana ꞌoamao siꞌewedi ga sieguyaiyedi taudimo ꞌediya, ta ꞌidi eguyai esasala ulaesinuwa ꞌenega, be ꞌabo yaita ꞌinugana tauna ꞌana ꞌoama ꞌida ꞌewa.
Ga muliyega simiyatowa sabi lomataꞌiꞌita.
Ta wate ꞌana kelose dabanaya siꞌetoladina, “Yesu tauna me Yudia ꞌadi toloina.” Nate ꞌina mwawasa ꞌalena.
Ta wate toꞌipwala ꞌeluwa sigiekeloseyedi, ꞌebweu Yesu ꞌatainaya ta ꞌebweu gegeuminaya.
Ta tomota ꞌaina ꞌedega Yesu kelose ꞌena situyeyena ta siedagiyena,
sigwae, “Nuwaꞌoleꞌoleyo! ꞌUona ꞌaene sawesawemuya Anuwa Tabu ꞌuligei be ꞌasiyata ꞌetoi soladiya ꞌuꞌabilima. Baga ꞌuda ꞌetoseyeyo tauyo be keloseyega ꞌuebusima, ꞌeguma ꞌoyo Yaubada natuna.”
Wate nadigega totaliyao sinabwadi be loina ꞌana toeꞌitao be ꞌinapwanao Yesu siꞌeetetena, ga sigwae,
“Mali tomota ꞌiꞌetoseyedi, ta tauna ꞌida ꞌetoseye! Tauna ꞌaene sena Isileli ꞌana toloina, abaga keloseyega ꞌiebusima be ꞌenega taemisei.
Tauna ꞌaene Yaubada ꞌana toemisa, ta ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌAboꞌagu Yaubada natuna.’ ꞌEnega ꞌeguma Yaubada nuwanuwana tauna ꞌida ꞌetoseye, aga?”
Ta toꞌipwala nidi Yesu maꞌenao sigie kelosediya, taudi ꞌadi keloseyega sibwaꞌonao ga taudi wate nadigega Yesu sibaꞌena.
Yesu ꞌina mwawasa
ꞌAsuoleoleyega ga ꞌasuinuwanuwaya ꞌasa maiboꞌana ꞌiguguyoi,
ga ꞌasuinuwanuwaya Yesu ꞌenana sinabwanega ꞌibwau ga ꞌigwae, Ol “Eli eli lama sabakitani!” Ta ꞌana gibui ꞌaene “ꞌIgu Yaubada, ꞌigu Yaubada, toꞌase manuna ꞌupilisinegu?”
Ta ꞌaina tomota selabenaya sitootoolo ꞌina bwau sinonona, ta sigwae, “Wanono! Tai gete Ilaitiya ꞌibwaubwauye.”
ꞌEnega ꞌebweuna ꞌediyega ꞌipili ga balou ꞌiꞌewena ga oine dalelena ꞌena ꞌietupaꞌutuina, ꞌenega ꞌebweu kaiwe ꞌena matana ꞌibadiyena ga ꞌieꞌetotuꞌeyena Yesu ꞌawanaya ga ꞌisokukuna.
Ta tai nina gosenao sigwae, “Tuga tayamwayamwa, nai ꞌiabe Ilaitiya ꞌimama be ꞌiꞌetoseye.”
Ta Yesu ꞌenana sinabwanega ꞌibwau limana, ga yawasina ꞌigumwala.
Ta kaleko nina Anuwa Tabu ꞌana pitaupa ꞌiesabuluwena etanega ga ꞌimwaꞌuta ꞌubunaya, ta mwaniꞌiniꞌi ꞌidedela, ga gulewa sinabwadi siepisalidi.
Ta wate ꞌaliꞌali ꞌawadi siꞌegegedi ga toemisao yaudi lowa simwawasaya kokowadi sitoolo limana,
ga Yesu ꞌina toolo limana mulinaya taudi wate ꞌaliꞌali ꞌediyega siapwesama, ga Yelusalema ꞌena silugu, ga tomota yaudi ꞌediya siapwesa.
Ta tolosaiyao nidi ma idi toanugana maꞌetamo Yesu siꞌitaꞌitaꞌiꞌisi, ga mwaniꞌiniꞌi be yage maiboꞌana siapwesaya siꞌitedi, ga simatauta sinabwana, ta sigwae, “Onaꞌaiꞌaila, tai gete Yaubada natuna.”
Yesu ꞌana saꞌuꞌaliꞌali
ꞌAina iine wate ꞌedasolega sidunedune, taudi lowa Galiliyega Yesu simuliyenamaya ta ꞌana masula siguiguinuwe,
ꞌebweuna ꞌana esana Meli Magidala, ta ꞌina waliyesa, tauna Yemesa be Yosepa sinadiya, ta wate Sebedi natunao sinadiya.
Ta ꞌasuinuwanuwaya ꞌebweu goma Alimatia ꞌimai Pailato ꞌenaya, tauna toesaesa, ta wate Yesu tauna ꞌana tomuliya ꞌebweu, ꞌana esana Yosepa.
Ga Pailato ꞌenaya Yesu kokowana ꞌisidena, ta Pailato ꞌitagwala be ꞌida ꞌewa.
ꞌEnega Yosepa ma ina ꞌaliꞌeiyao Yesu kokowana siꞌewena, ga ꞌoama wakewakekena ta ꞌesasena ꞌenega siwaduna,

ga Yosepa nina ꞌana ꞌaliꞌali auwauna ꞌena sisaꞌuna, ta ꞌaliꞌali nina sitainaya ꞌatuwa duluwa gulewa solanaya. Ta ꞌenega gulewa sinabwana ta pulipulina ꞌenega ꞌaliꞌali ꞌawana sisaꞌu bodena, ga muliyega Yosepa ꞌitauya.
Ta Meli Magidala ma ina waliyesa ꞌaliꞌali selabenaya simiyatowa ga sieꞌasiyedi.
ꞌAliꞌali siꞌitaꞌiꞌisina
Ta Yesu sigiekeloseyena me Yudia ꞌidi ꞌasiyata gibubu ꞌenaya, ꞌenega tomwa ꞌiulisina ga ꞌidi ꞌasiyata Sabate ꞌenaya totaliya sinabwadi be Palisiyao mabodadi sitauya Pailato ꞌenaya,
ta sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, tokabo nina lowa mayawasina ꞌimiyami ꞌina ona ꞌanuwaꞌiꞌisina ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌAsiyata ꞌetoi beo mwawasega yada toolo limana.’

ꞌEnega ꞌab kapekapeyana ꞌuloina be ꞌaliꞌali ꞌana toꞌitaꞌiꞌitao siꞌitaꞌiꞌita ꞌaiꞌaili be ꞌana laba ꞌasiyata ꞌetoi, ꞌabona nai ꞌina tononoyao simamai be Yesu kokowana siyai be sidene, be tomota sikaboedi ꞌaene ‘Mwawasega niꞌatu ꞌitoolo limana’, be ꞌenega kabo mulimuliyana kabo nuganuganina ꞌida toꞌumalisine.”
Ta Pailato ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌImi toꞌitaꞌiꞌitao tolosaiyao simiyami, watauyedi be ꞌaliꞌali silomataꞌiꞌita ꞌaiꞌaili.”
ꞌEnega sitauya ga ꞌaliꞌali ꞌawana ꞌana ꞌauboda gulewa nina wate sibwadena, ta nada toꞌitaꞌiꞌitao sietoolodi.
